consequence.statement: The release note announces a new additive capability (workload identity for remote clusters) and states no change to existing behavior, so an operator has no forced action or breakage implied by this item.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds workload identity support for remote clusters (RFC-0010) as a new capability.

decision.reason: [ev-a228b19b23ac] is a one-line CLI changelog entry that adds a new capability, workload identity support for remote clusters. Nothing in it or in the surrounding section says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. A related entry, [ev-c014b2928d8f], is also additive. For an environment that does nothing, the evidence supports kind "none" (informational). One caveat: the proposed statement says the note "states no change to existing behavior". The note does not say that; it is simply silent. The kind is still correct, which is why confidence is low.
